why: DGO-1382: the owner, 2026-11-04 18:31 UTC, «איך להגיע למקום ראשון בהמלצות של ai». The same 40 prompts every week, worded as a person asks, never edited once a run used them: a changed prompt is a new panel (aeo-panel-v2) and the baseline starts again.
measure: Whether an answer NAMES us, not where: AI recommendation lists differ between runs (SparkToro, January 2026), while the set of names an engine considers is stable. Per answer: named, our URLs cited, the alternatives named, every cited domain, and for brand prompts what the answer says about DGO against FACTS.md.
